attributes.board_name: Minnesota Board of Behavioral Health and Therapy

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved postdegree continuing education programs (Minn. R. 2150.2540); graduate credit (15 h per semester credit, 10 per quarter credit)
rules.new_licensee_rule: First 4 years of licensure: 12 graduate semester credits in counseling (CACREP or regionally accredited program, transcripts sent to the board) plus 40 hours of CE; graduate credits may count toward both.

topics.who: Serving clients from diverse socioeconomic and cultural backgrounds (culture, diversity and oppression, cultural humility)

rules.notes: After the first 4 years: 40 clock hours every 2 years. Affidavit of Continuing Education Compliance submitted at renewal.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Activities directly related to alcohol and drug counseling meeting statutory criteria: academic credit (1 semester credit = 15 h), workshops, seminars, in-service, teaching, presentations
rules.audit_note: Affidavit of CE compliance at renewal; random audits; keep original documentation 5 years.
rules.notes: Licensed alcohol and drug counselors are licensed by the same Board of Behavioral Health and Therapy.
